## 📝 Submission Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please ensure you have completed the following checklist. This helps us review and merge your package faster!

- [ ] **Namespace Rule**: My package is placed under a valid namespace (e.g., `packages/s/snowdreamtech/mypackage/`). Root-level packages are NOT allowed in the community registry.
- [ ] **Local Testing**: I have tested the package installation locally using the `unistack install` command or verified that the scripts work as intended.
- [ ] **YAML Linting**: My `package.yml` is valid YAML.
- [ ] **Security**: My package does not contain malicious scripts (Note: CI will run a sandbox installation test to verify).
- [ ] **CLA**: I understand I need to sign the CLA if this is my first time contributing. *(To sign, please comment on this PR with exactly: `I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA`)*
